# VendorIndex

> The reference coding agents consult to pick a vendor, library or service. Per-use-case
> scores from verified pricing, nightly-tested integration snippets, and an agent-friction
> score. Rank is never for sale; internet sentiment is unverified and never affects rank.

## Machine-readable data
- Full catalog in one fetch (plain text): /llms-full.txt
- Category rankings: /data/categories/<category>.json
- Vendor detail: /data/vendors/<vendor>.json
- MCP server (tools: search/compare/recommend/rank): https://vendorindex-mcp.anindyaju99.workers.dev (POST /mcp)

## Key pages
- Task pages: /task/send-<category>-from-<framework>/
- Category rankings: /category/<category>/
- Head-to-head: /compare/<a>-vs-<b>-vs-<c>/
- Vendor detail: /vendor/<vendor>/

Every number links to a source and a "verified on" date. Pricing is stored as structured
rates and computed at your usage, not copied from a tier table.
